content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Despite the severe clashes in Kiev, which at times have threatened to escalate, the EU should not intervene in local politics. Although Ukraine is a European country, and the Ukrainian opposition is primarily interested in installing a robust democracy, possible supporters face a considerably stronger opponent in the intervention of Russia in local politics.
What argument components exists in sentence "Despite the severe clashes in Kiev, which at times have threatened to escalate, the EU should not intervene in local politics" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<opp>Despite the severe clashes in Kiev, which at times have threatened to escalate,</opp> <pro>the EU should not intervene in local politics</pro>
